fact_english: A Mass was said on Easter Sunday, 31 March 1521, on the island Pigafetta called Mazaua. Pigafetta, the eyewitness, wrote that about fifty men landed and that the two rajahs were there, kissed the cross and knelt. The baptisms came at Cebu two weeks later. Where Mazaua was: Limasawa, according to the NHCP in 2020; Butuan, according to others. The Bakunawa is a folk tale of the Visayas and Bikol; a note of 1731 records people making noise at an eclipse.
source_onscreen: Pinagmulan: Pigafetta (salin ni Robertson); NHCP (2020); Ortiz (1731)

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Totoo ba 'yon, par? May misa talaga roon?
lines.say: totoo ba yon, par? may misa talaga roon?

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Tiyak: Linggo ng Pagkabuhay, 31 Marso 1521, sa islang tinawag ni Pigafetta na Mazaua.
lines.say: tiyak: linggo ng pagkabuhay, ika-tatlumpu't isa ng marso, isang libo limandaan at dalawampu't isa, sa islang tinawag ni pigafeta na masawa.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Sa Cebu pa ang binyagan, makalipas ang dalawang linggo.
lines.say: sa sebu pa ang binyagan, makalipas ang dalawang linggo.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Kung nasaan ang Mazaua, pinagtatalunan pa.
lines.say: kung nasaan ang masawa, pinagtatalunan pa.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Limasawa, ayon sa Komisyong Pangkasaysayan noong 2020; Butuan, ayon sa iba.
lines.say: limasawa, ayon sa komisyong pangkasaysayan noong dalawang libo't dalawampu; butuan, ayon sa iba.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Kuwentong-bayan ng Kabisayaan at Bikol ang Bakunawa.
lines.say: kuwentong-bayan ng kabisayaan at bikol ang bakunawa.

after_text: Ikaw, ka-Indio: kailan ka huling nag-video sa halip na tumingin?
why_here: The new form (BIBLE section 0, rule 7): the trivia goes at the END, after the last line of the story, as 'Patalastas ni Usman'. Spliced after the story's last line, not inside it.
voice_note: The script's six trivia turns are kept word for word; the three long INDIO turns are each split at a sentence or clause end into two caption-sized lines (same words, same order), as Episode 1 did. 'say' is plain lower case, no capitals inside a word: the years in Tagalog as the script's own SAY lines give 1521; NHCP spelled as letters; Mazaua as masawa; Cebu as sebu; umungol is u-MU-ngol (stress told to the voice, not written in capitals). facts.md section 5 asks for one more read of Pigafetta's Easter passage and one source for the Cebu baptisms (14 April 1521) before the build; the script's trivia runs longer than 25 seconds as written. 16 Nov (central): cut to 8 lines for length (the witness detail and the 1731 note dropped); NHCP said as 'Komisyong Pangkasaysayan'; the Mazaua line split in two; no fact added.
